rule_parameters.purpose: outgoing recoil shot parks a return/reward support
rule_parameters.core: outbound air shot freezes the same carrier later used for direct return or reward detour; choice persists
rule_parameters.external_goal: destination plus declared persistent carrier park; continuous return is separate fixture

parameters.purpose: outgoing recoil shot parks a return/reward support
parameters.core: outbound air shot freezes the same carrier later used for direct return or reward detour; choice persists
parameters.external_goal: destination plus declared persistent carrier park; continuous return is separate fixture

objective.core: outgoing recoil leaves carrier at middle for direct return or east for wider-gap reward transfer; exact bank shifted160 east after dominating old shortcut
objective.continuity_fixture_scope: Two exact continuous A-return fixture programs, no Module self-loops. Root fullcal+newheld must qualify them independently.
objective.prior_design_refutation: old D04 middle park gave faster C chest without any actual carrier support; old versions held, not counted as repaired

resource_state.entry: original supported fresh scene at A; every route has identical Cells and parked initial carrier
resource_state.exit: observed stable exit and route-specific carrier park; arbitrary states UNKNOWN

map_specification.return_conditions: Declared forward routes do not automatically validate return. Same-world fixtures exported separately and do not create extra ports.

migration_boundary_control_binding.scope: Continuous entry/exit controls only; no geometry or physics implementation changes.
